notes.title: Kitty's First Update
notes.notes:
There, Nyan! This is BOT the developer.
Since the game's release, we've had a lot of player feedback, and we've hurried to fix a few critical bugs (such as missing balloons after save).
We also included cheat codes! Try the following cheat code if you're stuck (press ~ to summon the console).

(Abusing cheat codes will make the game less enjoyable nyan!)

aspirine		Get a free battery
panzer			Get 50 free shells
richmore		Get three balloons
doraemon		Get the ticket and the tram controller
comeflywithme 	Baggy's happy gravity
shanghaied 		Teleport to Archipelago
link		 	Teleport to Snow Mountain Temple
tothemoon 		Teleport to the Rocket (caution)
